name: reimpl
description: Clean-room reimplementation of the E64 WS control service (WSS :39998, REST :38080, in-process ESP simulator). Drop this file into /tmp/equiv/targets/ to run the vendor scenarios against it.
notes: Start the service first: python3 -m e64ctl --state-dir /tmp/e64ctl --wss-port 39998 --http-port 38080
The reimpl has no HTTPS listener; scenarios that force 'secure' requests (secure:true) must use the plain HTTP base url, or run with --tls and a TLS-capable target.
Reset clears grind/brew/event rows and re-provisions Role.Owner.LoginData with the fixture password.
